captions.detailed: This 3D model features a concrete bell tower consisting of a tall rectangular shaft, a wider bottom base, and a flat top platform. Mounted on top of the platform is a dark grey steel yoke frame with diagonal cross-braces. A large, bronze-colored bell is suspended within this frame, designed to swing along a revolute joint axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a concrete bell tower with a plain rectangular shaft, a wider base, and a top platform. On the platform, mount a dark grey steel frame yoke supporting a large bronze-colored bell that can swing on a revolute joint.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by first building the static tower base, shaft, and platform using box primitives. Next, the steel yoke frame is created on top using thin box extrusions for the vertical posts, horizontal beams, and diagonal cross-braces. The bell is modeled using a combination of a cylinder and a cone (or a revolved profile) with a bronze material, which is then attached to the frame via a revolute joint with specified limits.
